## Kyoto Spring Trip Snapshot
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg

A 5-day Kyoto plan that keeps walking light, centers on temples and food markets, and stays practical from **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-14** for **2 adults**.
Budget target of **$2,400 excluding international flights** is very workable with a comfortable Kyoto Station base.

## Recommended Hotel, Itinerary, and Cost Plan

### Hotel near Kyoto Station: Best Fit
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

**Recommended stay:** a **mid-range hotel within a 5–10 minute walk of Kyoto Station**.
Best fit for your trip:
- Easy arrivals/departures and simple rail access for temple days
- Good for low-intensity walking and taxi backups
- Usually the best value for 2 adults in Kyoto

**What to book:**
- 3–4 star business or comfort hotel
- Twin or double room
- Breakfast optional, since markets are part of the plan
- Look for luggage storage and station-side access

**Typical budget:** **$120–$220 per night** before taxes/fees
For 4 nights: **$480–$880**

### 5-Day Kyoto Itinerary
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

| Day | Focus | Main Stops | Walking Load | Best Food Stop |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Apr 10 | Arrival + easy central Kyoto | Kyoto Station, Higashi Hongan-ji, Kyoto Tower area | Low | Kyoto Station food level |
| Apr 11 | Southern temple day | Fushimi Inari lower trails, Tofuku-ji, local lunch | Low to moderate | Fushimi area lunch |
| Apr 12 | Classic east Kyoto | Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, Yasaka Shrine, Gion | Moderate, can taxi between stops | Nishiki Market snack lunch |
| Apr 13 | Markets + zen temples | Nishiki Market, Nijo Castle area, Ryoan-ji or Daitoku-ji | Low | Nishiki Market |
| Apr 14 | Arashiyama light day + depart | Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji garden, river area | Low to moderate | Arashiyama lunch |

### Day-by-Day Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg

**Day 1: Easy arrival and station-area reset**
- Morning: Arrive, check in near Kyoto Station, rest
- Afternoon: Kyoto Station building, Higashi Hongan-ji, short nearby stroll
- Evening: Simple dinner in the station complex or nearby ramen/izakaya
- Food: Station depachika or Kyoto Station ramen street
- Action: [Button: Station-area map] https://www.google.com/maps/search/Kyoto+Station+area

**Day 2: Fushimi Inari and temple lunch**
- Morning: Fushimi Inari Taisha early, stay on the lower shrine paths
- Afternoon: Tofuku-ji temple gardens, return for rest by train or taxi
- Evening: Casual dinner near Kyoto Station
- Food: Udon, soba, or tofu set meal
- Action: [Button: Temple route] https://www.google.com/maps/search/Fushimi+Inari+to+Tofuku-ji

**Day 3: Higashiyama highlights**
- Morning: Kiyomizu-dera, then slow walk through Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka
- Afternoon: Yasaka Shrine, Maruyama Park, Gion streets
- Evening: Early dinner in Gion or Kawaramachi
- Food: Matcha sweets, yuba, or kaiseki-lite lunch
- Action: [Button: East Kyoto plan] https://www.google.com/maps/search/Kiyomizu-dera+Gion

**Day 4: Markets and calm temple time**
- Morning: Nishiki Market for breakfast snacks and tasting stops
- Afternoon: Nijo Castle or a quieter temple choice like Ryoan-ji
- Evening: Free time, shopping, or an onsen-style bathhouse if desired
- Food: Nishiki Market grazing lunch
- Action: [Button: Market guide] https://www.google.com/maps/search/Nishiki+Market+Kyoto

**Day 5: Arashiyama and departure buffer**
- Morning: Bamboo Grove early, Tenryu-ji garden, easy riverside walk
- Afternoon: Lunch in Arashiyama, return to Kyoto Station for departure prep
- Evening: Depart or final dinner if staying one more night
- Food: Tofu cuisine or soba in Arashiyama
- Action: [Button: Arashiyama route] https://www.google.com/maps/search/Arashiyama+Kyoto

### Rough Cost Estimate for 2 Adults
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-rupee.svg

| Category | Estimate | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Hotel (4 nights) | **$480–$880** | Mid-range Kyoto Station area |
| Local transit | **$60–$140** | Trains, buses, occasional taxis |
| Meals | **$360–$700** | Mix of markets, casual lunches, nicer dinners |
| Entrance fees | **$40–$120** | Temples, gardens, castle entries |
| Buffer / snacks / extras | **$150–$300** | Coffee, souvenirs, small surprises |
| Total | **$1,090–$2,140** | Fits within your **$2,400** budget |

### Budget Fit
- You can stay comfortably within budget without rushing.
- If you want a nicer hotel or a couple of special dinners, you still have room.
- The biggest cost lever is the hotel; transit and entrance fees stay relatively modest.
